remoteControl.intro: Send commands to the on-printer FilaMind screen.

locate.title: Locate the screen
locate.hint: Flash the screen so you can tell which printer it belongs to.

message.title: Send a message
message.placeholder: Type a short message to show on the screen…

overview.title: What this does
overview.body: This panel steers the on-printer FilaMind touchscreen from here: switch its tab, show it a short message, or flash it so you can tell which printer it is. These are display-only nudges — they never move the printer or change a setting.

commands.title: The commands
commands.body: Show jumps the screen to its Status, Control, or Settings tab. Locate flashes the screen for a few seconds. Message shows a short note (info or warning). Commands reach any FilaMind screen on this printer; nothing is sent while the command bus is still connecting.
